definitions.explanation: A meeting of the cabinet ministers of a government. In Japan, cabinet meetings are held regularly (usually twice a week) and all cabinet decisions require unanimous agreement.

examples.japanese: {閣議|かくぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was decided at a cabinet meeting.

examples.japanese: {閣議|かくぎ}⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A bill was submitted following the cabinet decision.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{閣議|かくぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あら}た→新た：01697_arata⟧な⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決定|けってい}した→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧。
examples.english: The government officially decided on new economic measures at this morning's cabinet meeting.

notes:
Composed of {閣|かく} (cabinet) and {議|ぎ} (deliberation). A key term in Japanese political news. The Japanese cabinet (⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧) holds regular meetings, and decisions made there (⟦{閣議決定|かくぎけってい}→閣議決定：27030_kakugikettei⟧) carry the weight of government policy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閣議|かくぎ}⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧: cabinet decision
- {閣議|かくぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a cabinet meeting
- {閣議|かくぎ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{了承|りょうしょう}する→了承する：20062_ryoushousuru⟧: to approve at a cabinet meeting
- {閣議|かくぎ}⟦{了解|りょうかい}→了解：05091_ryoukai⟧: cabinet understanding/agreement
- ⟦{臨時|りんじ}→臨時：04092_rinji⟧{閣議|かくぎ}: extraordinary cabinet meeting

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧: cabinet — the governing body itself
- ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧: National Diet/parliament — the legislative body, distinct from the cabinet
- ⟦{閣僚|かくりょう}→閣僚：20561_kakuryou⟧: cabinet minister — a member of the cabinet
